metadata.name: LoanCalculator
metadata.description: This API is to calculate the equal payment amount and total principal with given Loan amount and Loan term. It will also return the payment due and payment dates.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: LoanAmount
request_fields.description: The principal amount borrowed. It does not include interest. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2000.00

request_fields.name: LoanInterestRate
request_fields.description: The nominal interest rate. This the quoted interest rate for the loan. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 10.00

request_fields.name: LoanTerm
request_fields.description: Time period of Loan. Should be provided in months. If it is for 1year, Loan Term should be 12. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12

request_fields.name: InterestAccrualMethod
request_fields.description: How often payments should be scheduled, monthly/ daily. Valid Values: 1 - Daily , 2 - Monthly, Default value will be Monthly Refer Appendix for its explanation Example: 1

request_fields.name: LoanCalculationMethod
request_fields.description: Different method of Loan calculation. Valid Values: 1 - BestPayment, 2 - PMTformula, 3 - Advance Interest Calculation , Default will be PMTFormula Example: 1

request_fields.name: InterestOnInterest
request_fields.description: Interest that is earned when interest payments are reinvested. Valid Values: 0 - Yes, 1 - No, Default will be No Example: 1

request_fields.name: LastCycleInterest
request_fields.description: Interest of Last cycle need to be taken care as Bill Balance, Valid Values: 1 - BillBalance 2 - WaiveInterest 3 - AdditionalTerm 4 - Grace is applicable Default value will be Additional Term. Example: 3

request_fields.name: LoanDate
request_fields.description: Start date of your Loan. Default value will be current date. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

request_fields.name: PaymentDueDay
request_fields.description: Day on which first payment is due Valid Values: 1,2..30 Example: 10

request_fields.name: StatementDate
request_fields.description: Statement Date or billing cycle date. Default value will be end of the month. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

request_fields.name: YearBase
request_fields.description: Indicates the year base for interest calculations. Valid Values: 0= 365/366 1=365 2=360 Example: 1 Default value will be 365/366

request_fields.name: EqualPaymentAmount
request_fields.description: Equal Instalment Amount that is due on each payment date. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100.20 Condition: Either EqualPaymentAmount or LoanAmount is required

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TotalInterestDue
children.description: Assuming the debtor makes the payments as scheduled, this is the interest they will pay over the term of the loan. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 200.00

children.name: LoanAmount
children.description: The principal amount borrowed. It does not include interest. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 2000.00

children.name: NumberOfPayments
children.description: The "Payment Frequency" setting impacts the loan's term. For a loan term of five years, if the payment frequency is monthly, you need to enter 60 for the number of payments. (60 months = 5 years) Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 60

children.name: EqualPaymentAmount
children.description: The amount that is due on each payment due date. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1200.00

children.name: LoanDate
children.description: Start date of your Loan. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020

children.name: LoanTerm
children.description: Time period of Loan. Should be provided in months. If it is for 1year, Loan Term should be 12. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12

children.name: PaymentNumber
children.description: Payment Number of total number of payments. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12

children.name: StatementDate
children.description: Statement Date, Default value will be 30th. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/30/2020

children.name: LoanPaymentDueDate
children.description: Due date as to by when payment needs to be made to avoid late fees. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/30/2020

children.name: LoanInterestPayment
children.description: Amount of Interest Payment for the Installment Payment Number, Interest Earned by the Loan Provider. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 200.00

children.name: PrincipalPayment
children.description: The amount paid for current cycle, without the interest. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 200.00

children.name: RemainingLoanAmount
children.description: The balance amount due after the payment is made of current cycle. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 200.00
